title: Dilation formula for lintegrals on R^n
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and let R^n := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) carry Lebesgue measure. Let F : R^n → [0, ∞] be any function and E ⊆ R^n any set (neither is assumed measurable), and let t > 0 be real. Then ∫_E F(t x) dx = t^{-n} ∫_{E_t} F(y) dy, where E_t := {y ∈ R^n : t⁻¹ y ∈ E} (= tE). Both integrals are lintegrals with values in [0, ∞], and t^{-n} enters as ENNReal.ofReal ((t^n)⁻¹).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : Rn n → ℝ≥0∞) (E : Set (Rn n)) (t : ℝ), 0 < t → ∫⁻ x in E, F (t • x) = ENNReal.ofReal ((t ^ n)⁻¹) * ∫⁻ y in (fun y => t⁻¹ • y) ⁻¹' E, F y
